events.verdict: Suggs (ORL) briefly rests a hand on Jones' (PHX) body and the contact during his jump shot attempt is marginal.
Jones' (PHX) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Beal (PHX) steps into Suggs' (ORL) path and initiates leg contact that causes him to lose his balance.
Suggs (ORL)  legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot, making 'high-five' contact after the ball is released.
Beal (PHX) makes contact with Bitadze's (ORL) arm, which affects his shot attempt at the basket.
Bitadze (ORL) makes clean contact with the ball prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Black (ORL) brushes Booker's (PHX) side during his driving shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Morris (PHX) and Anthony (ORL) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Ighodaro (PHX) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Booker (PHX) steps into Black's (ORL) path but the contact is marginal.

Suggs (ORL) jumps from point A to point B into Booker (PHX), initiating contact that affects Booker's driving shot attempt at the basket. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul by Suggs does not meet the criteria for a flagrant foul.
Suggs (ORL) and Okogie (PHX) briefly engage and disengage and Okogie loses his footing on his own accord.
Suggs (ORL) extend his off-arm into Okogie's (PHX) head/face, initiating more-than-marginal contact.
Ighodaro (PHX) moves alongside Black's (ORL) path and he legally contests Black's driving shot attempt.
Suggs (ORL) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Okogie (PHX) commits a take foul on Caldwell-Pope (ORL).
Bitadze (ORL) legally contests Morris' (PHX) jump shot attempt.
